LanguageData.CCTO_ColdDeathTemperature_Desc: The plant dies when its ambient temperature falls below this value.
LanguageData.CCTO_ColdDamageStartTemperature_Desc: Damage accumulates below this temperature. Survival depends on cold intensity and duration.
LanguageData.CCTO_DormancyTemperature_Desc: When ambient temperature falls below this value, the plant enters cold dormancy. This value is the same as its minimum growth temperature.
